name: R4TextToClausesV1

request.text_type: built-in bytes; strings, bytearray, memoryview and all other types are UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA

lexical_artifact.output_decode: the unchanged core vocabulary, never reader aliases

lexing.encoding: strict UTF-8, with lowercase ASCII repertoire only
lexing.spans: half-open offsets into the unchanged original bytes; maximal words and each punctuation token have one span

fact_forms: O , not D , put the X in the L .
in the L , not D but O put the X .
not D but O put the X in the L .
in the L , O , not D , put the X .
syntax.query_form: where is the X owned by O , not D ? answer :
syntax.recognizer: boolean acceptance from unchanged token strings using literal and membership predicates; no semantic assignments, roles, gold data or answers are returned
syntax.boundaries: exactly four period tokens, each retained in its fact; nonempty query suffix ending in the three tokens ? answer :; no token follows the colon
syntax.clause_spans: first token start through final token end; surrounding and inter-clause whitespace excluded

refusal_precedence: schema and exact request field types
encoding and lexing in increasing byte order

byte_offsets.encoding_or_unknown_word: first offending byte, or beginning of the unknown maximal word
byte_offsets.missing_boundary_or_suffix: end-of-buffer when the absent token has no byte position
byte_offsets.appended_answer: first token after an existing ? answer : suffix
byte_offsets.wrong_suffix_token: first token inconsistent with ? answer : after its question mark; end-of-buffer for a missing token
byte_offsets.overlong_clause: fourteenth token start of the first overlong clause
byte_offsets.unsupported_syntax: first token start of the earliest clause that has no admitted form, or the first fact that breaks the form of fact zero; query failures use the query first token

surface_profiles.name: compact-space
surface_profiles.within_clause: no whitespace before punctuation . , ? :; one ASCII space before every other token except the first

surface_profiles.name: compact-lf
surface_profiles.within_clause: no whitespace before punctuation . , ? :; one ASCII space before every other token except the first

surface_profiles.name: separated-crlf
surface_profiles.within_clause: one ASCII space between every pair of tokens, including punctuation

surface_profiles.name: alternating-space-tab-lf
surface_profiles.within_clause: gaps cycle ASCII space, tab, LF by zero-based gap index, restarting at the start of each clause

generated_surfaces: no leading or trailing whitespace; adapter also accepts the declared whitespace outside all spans

derived_input_hash.string_framing: u32 little-endian UTF-8 byte length then exact string bytes
derived_input_hash.payload: 65 input IDs then five lengths as signed i64 little-endian in fact0, fact1, fact2, fact3, query order
derived_input_hash.excluded: raw bytes and spans; raw_text_sha256 separately binds exact original bytes

inference_boundary.state: stateless and atomic; one request replaces all four facts
inference_boundary.refusals: no partial parse, tensors, spans, token or answer; zero model forwards
inference_boundary.artifact_startup: wrapper verifies fixed reader/core/codec/frame/source identities before request access; unavailable startup returns UNAVAILABLE_ARTIFACT regardless of request
